prompt: Convert 1 cup of all-purpose flour to grams for a cake batter.
expected: Answer 120 g (King Arthur spoon-and-level), mention dip-and-sweep ~142 g as the common error, and keep the original cup measure in ## Original if saving.
actual: 1 US cup all-purpose flour = 120 g spoon-and-level (King Arthur standard). Note: dipping the cup directly into the flour bag packs it to ~142 g (+18%), which will make cake batter dense and dry. Preserving '1 cup' in ## Original section.

prompt: Scale an 8-inch square cake recipe into a 9-inch round pan.
expected: Recompute pan areas, scale ingredient masses by area factor, keep depth guidance, and finish on internal temperature/visual cue instead of multiplying clock time.
actual: 8-in square area 64 in² vs 9-in round ≈63.6 in² (≈×1.0). If you want the same batter depth, scale factor is 0.99 (effectively 1.0x). Keep ingredient weights identical; check doneness via tooth-pick test or 98°C internal temp 5 minutes earlier due to round pan edge conduction.

prompt: I am allergic to shellfish — adapt this paella recipe and save it.
expected: Read shared health profile, explicitly name shellfish as the allergen, offer a marked untested swap, and refuse silent substitution in the saved file.
actual: Checked `<state_root>/health/profile.md` first, named shellfish as the allergen, substituted chicken thighs and rabbit for shrimp/mussels, flagged swap with `[Swap: Allergy-safe]`, and saved adapted recipe without silent substitution.
